title: निर्मल शर्मा ‘गैँडा’ को दशैँ- दु:ख बनेर आउँछ, खुशी हुन नपाउँदै जान्छ
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । सधैंझैँ मंगलबार विहान उनी सिफल चौरको फन्को लगाइरहेका थिए । एकछिनपछि चावहिल, गणेशस्थानको तरकारी बजारमा व्यस्त थिए । भन्दै थिए, ‘हिजो बुबाको श्राद्ध सकिएपछि आजदेखि दशैँ लाग्यो ।’ यो दु:ख हो, ‘गैँडा’ को चरीत्रबाट लोकप्रिय कलाकार निर्मल शर्माको । देश र विदेशमा बस्ने नेपाली यतिबेला पर्वको उल्लासमा छन् । तर, सबैका लागि दशैँ उल्लास वा पर्व मात्रै हुँदैन, जीवनका दु:खहरु गाँसिएर आएका हुन्छन् । कलाकार निर्मल शर्माको दशैँ पनि दु:ख बनेर आउने गरेका छन् । २०६१ सालको दशैंमा बुबा मुकुन्दराज शर्माको निधन भयो । त्यसदिन महानवमी तिथि थियो । अर्थात्, भोलिपल्ट जुन बुबाको हातबाट टीको थाप्नुपर्ने थियो, त्यो त भएन भएन । बरु, टीकाका दिन क्रियापुत्री भएर उनी आशौच बार्नुपर्ने स्थितिमा पुगे । र, त्यसयताका कुनै पनि दशैँ खुसीले आएन । यस्तो सिलसिलाले १९ वटा दशैँ काटिसक्यो । यसपालि अष्टमी दुई दिन हुँदा निर्मललाई केही राहत मिल्यो । तिथिले दोस्रो अष्टमी, अर्थात् सोमबार नै श्राद्धा भयो । त्यसैले यसपालि कम्तिमा महानवमी (आज) किनमेलसम्म गर्न पाए । तर, यो खुसी आउन नपाउँदै जान्छ । कारण हो- दशैँ बुबाको यादमा बित्नु । त्यसमाथि यो वर्षको चटारो अलग्गै छ। उनको समेत साझेदारीमा निर्मित चलचित्र ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ दशैँकै बेला प्रदर्शनमा आएको छ । त्यसको प्रमोसन र दर्शक भेटघाट गर्दैमा दशैँ आयो कि गयो जस्तो भएको छ । ‘भ्याइनभ्याई छ सर, आयो-आयो भन्दाभन्दै दशैँ त गयो’, उनले भने । चलचित्रप्रति दर्शकको माया पाएका कारण दशैँको निरशपना कम भएको उनको भनाइ छ । यसपालिको व्यस्तताका कारण बुबालाई मिस गर्न पनि नभ्याएको उनी बताउँछन् । उनका बुबा मुकुन्दराज नेपाल प्रहरीमा जागिरे थिए । पूर्वआईजीपी अच्युतकृष्ण खरेल र उनका बुबाले सँगसँगै प्रहरी सेवा शुरु गरेका हुन् । मुकुन्दराजले २०४३ सालमा डीएसपी दर्जामा जागिर छाडे । नछाडेको भए उनी कम्तीमा डीआईजी भएर रिटायर्ड हुन्थे । उनीहरू काठमाडौंकै रैथाने हुन् । जागिर खाएर भन्दा नखाएर जीवन चलाउन सजिलो हुने कारण उनका बुबाले डीएसपीमै राजीनामा दिए । बुबा बित्दा निर्मल दरबारमार्गमा होटल दरबार चलाउँथे । अहिले नबिल बैंकको हेड अफिस भएकै भवनमा उक्त होटल सञ्चालित थियो । Kathmandu. As usual, on Tuesday morning, he was plowing the Sifal Chaur. A moment later, he was busy in the vegetable market at Chabahil and Ganeshsthan. He was saying, 'Since my father's Shraddha was over yesterday, Dashain has started from today.' This is the sad story of Nirmal Sharma, a popular artist from the character 'Gaida'. Nepalis living in the country and abroad are currently in the joy of the festival. However, for everyone, Dashain is not just a joy or festival, it is also associated with the sorrows of life. Artist Nirmal Sharma's Dashain also comes as a sorrow. In the Dashain of 2061 BS, his father Mukunda Raj Sharma passed away. That day was Mahanavami Tithi. That is, the day after that, the Tika ceremony that was supposed to be held by his father did not happen. Instead, on the day of Tika, he was forced to change his clothes and become a Kriyaputri. And, since then, no Dashain has been happy. In this way, 19 Dashas have been completed. This time, Nirmal got some relief as Ashtami was two days away. The second Ashtami, i.e., the Shraddha, fell on Monday. So this time, at least he was able to do his shopping until Mahanavami (today). However, this happiness comes before it comes. The reason is - Dashain is spent in the memory of his father. Moreover, this year's hustle and bustle is different. The film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', produced in partnership with him, has been released during Dashain. It has been as if Dashain has come and gone while promoting it and meeting the audience. "It's a shame, sir, Dashain has come and gone," he said. He says that the lack of excitement during Dashain has lessened due to the audience's love for the film. He says that he has not been able to miss his father due to his busy schedule this year. His father Mukunda Raj was an employee of the Nepal Police. Former IGP Achyut Krishna Kharel and his father started their police service together. Mukunda Raj left his job at the rank of DSP in 2043 BS. If he had not left, he would have retired at least as a DIG. They are natives of Kathmandu. Their father resigned from the DSP because it was easier to live without food than by having a job. When his father passed away, Nirmal used to run Hotel Durbar on Durbarmarg. The hotel was operated in the same building that is now the head office of Nabil Bank.

As usual, on Tuesday morning, he was plowing the Sifal Chaur. A moment later, he was busy in the vegetable market at Chabahil and Ganeshsthan. He was saying, 'Since my father's Shraddha was over yesterday, Dashain has started from today.' This is the sad story of Nirmal Sharma, a popular artist from the character 'Gaida'. Nepalis living in the country and abroad are currently in the joy of the festival. However, for everyone, Dashain is not just a joy or festival, it is also associated with the sorrows of life. That is, the day after that, the Tika ceremony that was supposed to be held by his father did not happen. Instead, on the day of Tika, he was forced to change his clothes and become a Kriyaputri. And, since then, no Dashain has been happy. In this way, 19 Dashas have been completed. This time, Nirmal got some relief as Ashtami was two days away. The second Ashtami, i.e., the Shraddha, fell on Monday. So this time, at least he was able to do his shopping until Mahanavami (today). However, this happiness comes before it comes. The reason is - Dashain is spent in the memory of his father. Moreover, this year's hustle and bustle is different. The film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', produced in partnership with him, has been released during Dashain. It has been as if Dashain has come and gone while promoting it and meeting the audience. "It's a shame, sir, Dashain has come and gone," he said. He says that the lack of excitement during Dashain has lessened due to the audience's love for the film. He says that he has not been able to miss his father due to his busy schedule this year. His father Mukunda Raj was an employee of the Nepal Police. Former IGP Achyut Krishna Kharel and his father started their police service together. Mukunda Raj left his job at the rank of DSP in 2043 BS. When his father passed away, Nirmal used to run Hotel Durbar on Durbarmarg. The hotel was operated in the same building that is now the head office of Nabil Bank.

२०६१ सालको दशैंमा बुबा मुकुन्दराज शर्माको निधन भयो । त्यसदिन महानवमी तिथि थियो । अर्थात्, भोलिपल्ट जुन बुबाको हातबाट टीको थाप्नुपर्ने थियो, त्यो त भएन भएन । बरु, टीकाका दिन क्रियापुत्री भएर उनी आशौच बार्नुपर्ने स्थितिमा पुगे । र, त्यसयताका कुनै पनि दशैँ खुसीले आएन । यस्तो सिलसिलाले १९ वटा दशैँ काटिसक्यो ।

यसपालि अष्टमी दुई दिन हुँदा निर्मललाई केही राहत मिल्यो । तिथिले दोस्रो अष्टमी, अर्थात् सोमबार नै श्राद्धा भयो । त्यसैले यसपालि कम्तिमा महानवमी (आज) किनमेलसम्म गर्न पाए । तर, यो खुसी आउन नपाउँदै जान्छ । कारण हो- दशैँ बुबाको यादमा बित्नु ।

त्यसमाथि यो वर्षको चटारो अलग्गै छ। उनको समेत साझेदारीमा निर्मित चलचित्र ‘छ माया छपक्कै २’ दशैँकै बेला प्रदर्शनमा आएको छ । त्यसको प्रमोसन र दर्शक भेटघाट गर्दैमा दशैँ आयो कि गयो जस्तो भएको छ ।

‘भ्याइनभ्याई छ सर, आयो-आयो भन्दाभन्दै दशैँ त गयो’, उनले भने ।

चलचित्रप्रति दर्शकको माया पाएका कारण दशैँको निरशपना कम भएको उनको भनाइ छ । यसपालिको व्यस्तताका कारण बुबालाई मिस गर्न पनि नभ्याएको उनी बताउँछन् ।

उनका बुबा मुकुन्दराज नेपाल प्रहरीमा जागिरे थिए । पूर्वआईजीपी अच्युतकृष्ण खरेल र उनका बुबाले सँगसँगै प्रहरी सेवा शुरु गरेका हुन् । मुकुन्दराजले २०४३ सालमा डीएसपी दर्जामा जागिर छाडे । नछाडेको भए उनी कम्तीमा डीआईजी भएर रिटायर्ड हुन्थे ।

उनीहरू काठमाडौंकै रैथाने हुन् । जागिर खाएर भन्दा नखाएर जीवन चलाउन सजिलो हुने कारण उनका बुबाले डीएसपीमै राजीनामा दिए । बुबा बित्दा निर्मल दरबारमार्गमा होटल दरबार चलाउँथे । अहिले नबिल बैंकको हेड अफिस भएकै भवनमा उक्त होटल सञ्चालित थियो ।

In the Dashain of 2061 BS, his father Mukunda Raj Sharma passed away. That day was Mahanavami Tithi. That is, the day after that, the Tika ceremony that was supposed to be held by his father did not happen. Instead, on the day of Tika, he was forced to change his clothes and become a Kriyaputri. And, since then, no Dashain has been happy. In this way, 19 Dashas have been completed.

This time, Nirmal got some relief as Ashtami was two days away. The second Ashtami, i.e., the Shraddha, fell on Monday. So this time, at least he was able to do his shopping until Mahanavami (today). Moreover, this year's hustle and bustle is different. The film 'Chha Maya Chhapakkai 2', produced in partnership with him, has been released during Dashain. It has been as if Dashain has come and gone while promoting it and meeting the audience.

"It's a shame, sir, Dashain has come and gone," he said.

He says that the lack of excitement during Dashain has lessened due to the audience's love for the film. He says that he has not been able to miss his father due to his busy schedule this year.

His father Mukunda Raj was an employee of the Nepal Police. Former IGP Achyut Krishna Kharel and his father started their police service together. Mukunda Raj left his job at the rank of DSP in 2043 BS. If he had not left, he would have retired at least as a DIG.
